annotations.text:
Direction: Quiet Paper.
One rule — colour belongs to notes, never to chrome. No gradients, no accent bars, no filled pills. Hairlines and type carry the hierarchy.
Type: Instrument Sans (UI) + Newsreader (note bodies) + JetBrains Mono (counts, code, zoom).

Alternate direction, not the deliverable. Same no-colour-in-chrome rule taken further: dark, mono-labelled, notes as flat dark cards with a single hue dot. Pick this instead if you want the app to read as a tool rather than as paper.
